christina-m-fraga-saenz.text: (2024) Per the AV Press, spoke as a member of the public and 25-year resident of the Boulders mobile home park in support of raising rents at Palmdale's city-owned mobile home parks (recusing from the Housing Authority vote).

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Higher rents in mobile home parks are OK'd (2024-04-05)

christina-m-fraga-saenz.text: As organizer of the volunteer Desert Dumping Task Force, which works with Palmdale on illegal-dumping cleanups: "We removed over 5,000 tons of trash... It's about empowering the next generation to know that this isn't right. We've got to protect our Earth."

source.title: Antelope Valley Press: Message at Earth Day event: recycle, protect environment (2026-04-28)
